# Final Project Validation

## Purpose

Validate the implemented challenge against its functional and quality gates.

## When to use

Use when explicitly asked for final project validation or delivery readiness.

## Essential project rules

- Verify acceptance accounting, FIX report semantics, snapshot atomicity, idempotency, communication failures and reproducible documentation from actual evidence.
- Report unexecuted or unavailable checks; do not imply that planned functionality is implemented.

Read the [repository instructions](../../copilot-instructions.md), applicable path-specific instructions and the [approved execution plan](../../docs/plan.md).

## Procedure

Inspect actual implementation and evidence; validate financial, FIX, web, security, tests and documentation. Use independent specialists only when available and permitted, distinguish direct checks and mark unavailable or unexecuted gates as blocked.
